posts.zh:
dsh-plugin-open-app 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。把 open-mcp-apps 接进 DSH：每个 MCP app 都是侧边栏里自己的容器，带独立 workspace、会话与 App mode，应用下方是 agent 状态条，普通聊天里也能行内渲染 app。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-6f9a7a3c8b813cc8827d.html
posts.en:
dsh-plugin-open-app is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Runs open-mcp-apps inside DSH: every MCP app gets its own sidebar container with a separate workspace, session, and App mode, an agent status strip under the app, and inline app rendering in ordinary chats.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-6f9a7a3c8b813cc8827d.html
